name: OneFinOps
description_en:
OneFinOps presents a hosted ERP suite with financial management, procurement, supply chain, projects, subscriptions and an AI platform. The accounting component connects operating documents with ledgers, rather than describing an isolated expense tracker.

The official root redirected this research to the India-facing /in site. This profile concentrates on the accounting and payables pages actually read; country selectors and displayed example records do not prove country-specific compliance or live customer outcomes. No system access, posting or approval was tested.
description_zh:
OneFinOps 将自身定位为托管 ERP 套件，包含财务管理、采购、供应链、项目、订阅及 AI 平台。其会计组件把业务单据与账簿相连，不是单独的费用跟踪器。

官方根地址本次跳转至面向印度的 /in 站点。本文聚焦实际读取的会计及应付页面；国家选择器和网页示例记录不能证明各国合规或真实客户效果。未测试系统访问、过账或审批。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the accounting core within the suite
sections.title_zh: 在套件内评估会计核心
sections.en:
The accounting page describes a ledger per entity, journal entries, account mapping, fixed assets, closing, consolidation and opening balances. Procurement, inventory, subscriptions and other domains are separately named parts of the suite. A buying decision must specify which modules and records are in scope, rather than assume every navigation entry belongs to the same package.

This may be worth evaluating for a finance team that wants source documents and approvals tied to the ledger. A team needing only invoice PDFs should first assess whether it can own the broader configuration. These are editorial judgments about documented scope; the research did not verify the vendor’s implementation-duration, savings or customer-adoption claims.
sections.zh:
会计页面介绍按实体设置账簿、日记账、科目映射、固定资产、结账、合并和期初余额。采购、库存、订阅等领域则是套件中另行命名的部分。采购时必须明确模块与记录范围，不能认定导航里每一项都属于同一套餐。

希望把源单据、审批与总账连接起来的财务团队可以评估；只需要发票 PDF 的团队应先判断能否负责更广配置。这是基于文档范围的编辑判断；本文未核实实施周期、节省或客户采用主张。

sections.title_en: Trace a journal back to its operating document
sections.title_zh: 把日记账追踪回业务单据
sections.en:
The website illustrates a path from a ledger balance to a journal, then an invoice and sales order. It also shows entity books mapped into a group chart, and opening balances compared with the prior system. These examples explain the intended inspection path, not an audited transaction history.

A useful acceptance case is one customer invoice plus a later credit note: compare the source documents, journal effects and customer balance, and confirm the entity and period. For migration, reconcile the full opening trial balance, not just the grand total or a sample screenshot. The public page does not establish how your historical documents, identifiers and attachments would convert.
sections.zh:
官网用示例展示从账簿余额进入日记账，再到发票和销售订单的路径；还展示实体账簿映射到集团科目，以及期初余额与旧系统对照。这些例子说明预期追查方式，不是经审计的交易历史。

可用一张客户发票及后续贷项通知验收，对照源单据、日记账影响和客户余额，并确认实体与期间。迁移时应对完整期初试算平衡表，而非只看总额或示例截图。公开页面不能证明自身历史单据、标识和附件将如何转换。

sections.title_en: Resolve a matching exception before releasing payment
sections.en:
The payables page describes matching a vendor invoice with its purchase order and goods receipt, routing approvals by the organization’s matrix, checking duplicates and changed bank information, and carrying the accounting effect into the ledger. Its illustrated price-variance and approval amounts are vendor examples rather than benchmark data.

For a hypothetical order of ten units, receive eight and invoice ten. Ask the demonstration to show where the quantity exception stops the process, who resolves it and whether a payment run can still include the bill. Also submit a duplicate invoice identifier and an unverified bank change. These are proposed checks of advertised controls; none were executed, and an AI label does not establish that financial authorization can be delegated safely.
sections.zh:
应付页面介绍供应商发票与采购订单、收货单匹配，按组织审批矩阵流转，检查重复和银行资料变更，并把会计影响记入总账。页面中的价差和审批金额属于厂商示例，不是基准测试数据。

以假设的十件订单为例，只收八件却收到十件发票，可要求演示数量异常在哪里停止流程、由谁解决，以及付款批次是否仍能纳入该账单；再检查重复发票标识和未经验证的银行变更。这些只是针对宣传控制的建议检查，均未执行；AI 标签不能证明可以安全委托财务授权。

sections.title_en: Configuration decides what a blocked posting means
sections.title_zh: 配置决定过账阻止的含义
sections.en:
The accounting page describes period locks, approval thresholds, separation of preparer and approver, account rules and ledger settings such as rate types and fiscal calendars. Set the real entity structure, chart, currencies, periods, approval matrix and opening balances before evaluating a complete close.

Ask for one blocked-period entry, one entry requiring approval and a correction after review, then inspect the resulting evidence. The page’s close checklist still shows dependencies such as bank reconciliation and revaluation; a continuous-ledger claim does not prove every period can close without unresolved work. Supported statutory formats, tax submission, access controls and recovery must be verified for the actual jurisdiction and account.
sections.zh:
会计页介绍期间锁定、审批阈值、制单人与审批人分离、科目规则，以及汇率类型和会计日历等账簿设置。评估完整结账前，应先设置真实实体结构、科目、币种、期间、审批矩阵和期初余额。

可要求演示锁定期间的分录、需要审批的分录及复核后更正，再检查证据。页面的结账清单仍包含银行对账和重估等依赖；持续更新账簿的主张不能证明所有期间都没有未处理工作。法定格式、税务提交、访问控制和恢复需按真实地区及账户验证。

sections.title_en: A demo leads to entity-and-module pricing
sections.title_zh: 演示后按实体与模块报价
sections.en:
The official demo page read on 22 October 2026 says pricing is scoped to entities and modules, rather than seats. It offers a walkthrough with the prospect’s entity structure, close calendar and controls, followed by a scoped price. No public currency amount, minimum contract, permanent free plan or implementation price was established.

Prepare the number of legal entities, selected modules, integrations, migration scope and statutory requirements for that discussion. Ask which services and environments are included and what is billed separately; those remain questions rather than verified fee categories. No form was submitted, no account was created and the promised walkthrough was not observed. Source access or a GitHub link does not establish a license to self-host this ERP.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的官方演示页说明，价格按实体和模块确定，而非按席位；可结合潜在客户的实体结构、结账日历及控制要求演示，再提供对应范围报价。本次未确立公开币种金额、最低合同、永久免费套餐或实施费。

沟通前准备法律实体数、所选模块、集成、迁移范围和法定要求，并询问包含哪些服务与环境、哪些另计；这些仍是问题，不能当作已核实收费类别。本文未提交表单、创建账户或观察承诺中的演示。能看到源码入口或 GitHub 链接，也不能证明获得此 ERP 自托管许可。

research_gaps.en: Country-specific statutory and filing behavior, contracted modules, AI permissions, migration and restore were not tested.
